scope: Isolated Chromium UI review, not a browser-played campaign. Fresh school prepared with public build/tick/workforce APIs; late fixture imported from the separately recorded earned simulation campaign. UI buttons perform the reviewed actions. Clock skips are explicit.

checks.name: Council exposes research and charter prerequisites before spending
Visible research action charges knowledge and displays staffed progress
Research progress survives reload and the UI changes to Learned
Stores shows every resource, physical capacity, services and production chains
Trade UI accepts then delivers a real order, with dates, costs and named trust
Earned checkpoint restores the late town and an explicit priced charter choice
Harbor counter imports and exports spend exact quotes, with visible quotas preserved on reload
An earned town can queue and complete an upgrade through the inspector
Trade UI dispatches earned cargo and reports its actual return date
Watch shows a real warning, patrol progress, exact shelter/payment costs and a quiet record
